descriptionChirho: To have sufficient physical capacity to hold or contain something, said of vessels, buildings, or spaces (Hifil and Qal stems, also Piel with object suffixes referring to spatial capacity)
To supply food and material provision for someone, to sustain or nourish dependents over time (Piel stem in active voice)
To be furnished with provisions or sustenance, passive of the sustain/provide sense (Pual stem)
To be able to endure, bear, or withstand something difficult; to hold oneself back or restrain (Piel and Hifil stems with psychological/emotional sense)
To direct or manage the affairs of something, to conduct business or governance (Piel stem in administrative sense)
